evidence.claim: In FY2025, Australian operations used 12000 MWh of electricity and reported Scope 1 emissions of 1800 tCO2e and Scope 2 emissions of 2400 tCO2e. Scope 3 has not yet been measured.
The FY2025 safety register records 4 lost-time injuries across 400 employees. The safety committee reviews incidents monthly and assigns corrective action owners.
The board sustainability committee reviews climate risks quarterly. The CFO maintains the climate risk register and reports mitigation progress to the committee.
